segments.ipa: /ðæts wɛn aɪ ˈriəˌlaɪzd aɪd lɛft maɪ foʊn æt hoʊm ˈɛniˌweɪ/

segments.text: I guess missing that train wasn't such a bad thing after all.
segments.ipa: /aɪ ɡɛs ˈmɪsɪŋ ðæt treɪn ˈwɑzənt sʌtʃ ə bæd θɪŋ ˈæftər ɔl/

segments.text: The silver lining was that I had time to go back home, grab my phone,
segments.ipa: /ðə ˈsɪlvər ˈlaɪnɪŋ wɑz ðæt aɪ hæd taɪm tu ɡoʊ bæk hoʊm ɡræb maɪ foʊn/

segments.text: and let my boss know I'd be late.
segments.ipa: /ənd lɛt maɪ bɑs noʊ aɪd bi leɪt/

segments.text: Guys, thank you so much for sticking around to the end of this video.
segments.ipa: /ɡaɪz θæŋk ju soʊ mʌtʃ fɔr ˈstɪkɪŋ ərˈaʊnd tu ðə ɛnd ʌv ðɪs ˈvɪdioʊ/

segments.text: I hope you found this shadowing practice useful.
segments.ipa: /aɪ hoʊp ju faʊnd ðɪs ˈʃædoʊɪŋ ˈpræktəs ˈjusfəl/

segments.text: I will continue to put out more shadowing videos because you guys request them so much.
segments.ipa: /aɪ wɪl kənˈtɪnju tu pʊt aʊt mɔr ˈʃædoʊɪŋ ˈvɪdioʊz bɪˈkɔz ju ɡaɪz rɪˈkwɛst ðɛm soʊ mʌtʃ/

segments.text: Go check out my shadowing playlist, which I'm building all the time.
segments.ipa: /ɡoʊ tʃɛk aʊt maɪ ˈʃædoʊɪŋ ˈpleɪlɪst wɪtʃ aɪm ˈbɪldɪŋ ɔl ðə taɪm/

segments.text: More shadowing videos definitely to come.
segments.ipa: /mɔr ˈʃædoʊɪŋ ˈvɪdioʊz ˈdɛfənətli tu kʌm/

segments.text: So, let me know in the comments what you'd like me to focus on.
segments.ipa: /soʊ lɛt mi noʊ ɪn ðə ˈkɑmɛnts wʌt jud laɪk mi tu ˈfoʊkəs ɑn/

segments.text: Maybe there's a specific word or group of words that you struggle with in terms of pronunciation or when you are speaking very quickly or maybe it's an
segments.ipa: /ˈmeɪbi ðɛrz ə spəˈsɪfɪk wɝd ɔr ɡrup ʌv wɝdz ðæt ju ˈstrʌɡəl wɪð ɪn tɝmz ʌv proʊˌnʌnsiˈeɪʃən ɔr wɛn ju ɑr ˈspikɪŋ ˈvɛri ˈkwɪkli ɔr ˈmeɪbi ɪts æn/

segments.text: inflection or a tone or maybe you want me to add more idioms or phrasal verbs in a shadowing practice.
segments.ipa: /ˌɪnˈflɛkʃən ɔr ə toʊn ɔr ˈmeɪbi ju wɑnt mi tu æd mɔr ˈɪdiəmz ɔr phrasal vɝbz ɪn ə ˈʃædoʊɪŋ ˈpræktəs/

segments.text: I can also go over some of those so that we can kill two birds with one stone and have a shadowing practice while also learning new vocabulary.
segments.ipa: /aɪ kæn ˈɔlsoʊ ɡoʊ ˈoʊvər sʌm ʌv ðoʊz soʊ ðæt wi kæn kɪl tu bɝdz wɪð wʌn stoʊn ənd hæv ə ˈʃædoʊɪŋ ˈpræktəs waɪl ˈɔlsoʊ ˈlɝnɪŋ nu voʊˈkæbjəˌlɛri/

segments.text: So, let me know what you guys want to see from me next, particularly my members.
segments.ipa: /soʊ lɛt mi noʊ wʌt ju ɡaɪz wɑnt tu si frʌm mi nɛkst ˌpɑrˈtɪkjələrli maɪ ˈmɛmbərz/

segments.text: You guys get priority reply in the comment section.
segments.ipa: /ju ɡaɪz ɡɛt praɪˈɔrəti rɪˈplaɪ ɪn ðə ˈkɑmɛnt ˈsɛkʃən/

segments.text: If you're interested in joining my channel as a member, click the join button below and you'll get to see more information about that.
segments.ipa: /ɪf jʊr ˈɪntrəstɪd ɪn ˈdʒɔɪnɪŋ maɪ ˈtʃænəl æz ə ˈmɛmbər klɪk ðə dʒɔɪn ˈbʌtən bɪˈloʊ ənd jul ɡɛt tu si mɔr ˌɪnfərˈmeɪʃən əˈbaʊt ðæt/

segments.text: I'm so grateful for the support.
segments.ipa: /aɪm soʊ ˈɡreɪtfəl fɔr ðə səˈpɔrt/

segments.text: Happy shadowing, guys, and I'll see you next time.
segments.ipa: /ˈhæpi ˈʃædoʊɪŋ ɡaɪz ənd aɪl si ju nɛkst taɪm/

segments.text: Bye for now.
segments.ipa: /baɪ fɔr naʊ/
